search_text: published ZDI-07-058 ZDI-CAN-159 Oracle E-Business Suite SQL Injection Vulnerability 2007-10-31 CVE-2007-5766 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2007-5766 ['Oracle / PeopleSoft'] ['E-Business Suite'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary SQL on vulnerable installations of Oracle E-Business Suite. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists in the okxLOV.jsp page in the Administration console. This page allows an attacker to specify arguments to a WHERE SQL command without sanitation, allowing for arbitrary SQL injection in the context of the APPS user. Oracle / PeopleSoft has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
